scripture.verse: "But put you on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfill the lusts thereof."

sermons.title: Sermon 2133 | "My God, My God, Why Have You Forsaken Me?"

scripture.verse: "And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, crying, Eli, Eli, lama Sabachthani? that is to say, My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"

"O Ephraim, what shall I do to you? O Judah, what shall I do to you? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goes away. Therefore ha ve I hewed them by the Prophets; I have slain them by the Words of My mouth: and your judgments are as the light that goes forth."

sermons.title: Sermon 2135 | The Warnings and the Rewards of the Word of God

scripture.verse: "Moreover by them is Your servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward."
"But upon Mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions."

sermons.title: Sermon 2138 | The Shank-bone Sermon—Or, True Believers and Their Helpers

scripture.verse: "Who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through Grace."
"And killed the Prince of Life, whom God has raised from the dead, of which we are witnesses."

sermons.title: Sermon 2140 | A Homily for Humble Folks

scripture.verse: "Surely I am more stupid than any man, and have not the understanding of a man."
"Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when He had found him, He said unto him, Do you believe on the Son of God?"
